data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Coinbase Wallet mobile SDK
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to integrate with the Coinbase Wallet mobile SDK on Android and iOS. It enables actions like initiating handshakes, requesting accounts, and signing messages using web3 methods.
use_when: You need to connect your Flutter app to Coinbase Wallet
You are implementing web3 authentication or transaction signing with Coinbase
avoid_when: You need to support platforms other than Android and iOS
You want a general-purpose wallet solution not tied specifically to Coinbase
strengths: Official Flutter implementation for Coinbase Wallet SDK
Supports core web3 actions like eth_requestAccounts and personalSign
weaknesses: Only supports iOS and Android platforms
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration in Dart and handling deep links in Swift for iOS.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative for interacting with Ethereum blockchain and wallets.
